notes.title: We’ve decided to get closer and launch a Q&A!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, friends!
[/h3][p]The [b]Kanun 1919[/b] team is here! In our studio, we always keep one thing in mind — a good game is made [i]with the community and for the community[/i].
[/p][p]That’s why we’ve decided to get closer and launch a [b]Q&A[/b]!
[/p][p]Ask your questions in the comments — about the story, atmosphere, gameplay, or anything else. In the next post, we’ll gather the most popular ones and answer them in detail.
[/p][p]Thank you for following the game — your support motivates us to keep going ❤️
[/p][p]In the meantime, don’t forget to add [b]Kanun 1919[/b] to your wishlist and join our [b]Community Hub[/b] — so you won’t miss any of the exciting news 😉[/p][p][/p]
